instruction: Move picture3.jpg from the Pictures folder to the Desktop.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent opened Files, navigated to Pictures, right-clicked and renamed all 3 picture files. Got picture1→Mount Kilimanjaro (correct), picture2→Mount Everest (correct), but picture3→Mount Kailash (wrong, should be Huashan). Score 0 because evaluator requires all correct.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open file manager, navigate directories, right-click files, use Rename dialog, type new names. Successfully performed 3 rename operations.
metadata.failure_analysis: Model misidentified picture3 (Huashan/Mount Hua plank path) as Mount Kailash. The all-or-nothing evaluator gave 0 despite 2/3 correct renames.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests simple file move operation. Model demonstrated strong file manager navigation and right-click context menu usage. Moving a file is simpler than identifying and renaming.
metadata.explanation: Task asks to move one file from Pictures to Desktop. Getter checks file existence at source and destination. Metric gives 0.7 for file at destination, 0.3 for file removed from source.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks file existence at both source (/home/user/Pictures) and destination (/home/user/Desktop) using bash 'test -f', returning {src_exists, dst_exists} dict.
Metric correctly awards partial credit: 0.7 for file at destination, 0.3 for file removed from source, totaling 1.0 for a complete move. This accurately verifies the instruction.
Complete coverage: the instruction only requires moving picture3.jpg, and both aspects of a move (appears at destination, removed from source) are verified.

Minor issue: metric ignores the 'expected' parameter entirely — scoring is hardcoded. The expected.rules (expect_at_destination, expect_removed_from_source) are never consulted. For this specific task the hardcoded logic produces the correct result.
Minor issue: bash commands don't quote file paths (test -f {src_dir}/{file_name}), but picture3.jpg has no spaces so this works correctly here.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider having the metric reference the expected parameter to make it reusable (e.g., check expected['expect_at_destination'] before awarding the 0.7 points).
Quote file paths in bash commands to handle filenames with spaces: test -f "{src_dir}/{file_name}"
